findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_lookalike_domains" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find lookalike domains of a brand's website: typos, swapped letters, look-alike characters, added words and other TLDs. Checks which of them resolve in DNS and what their front page shows (a page using the brand's name, a redirect to the brand's own site, another live site, or nothing). Read-only. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
